title: Continual Uncertainty Learning for Robust Control of Nonlinear Systems with Multiple Heterogeneous Uncertainties
abstract: arXiv:2602.17174v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robust control of mechanical systems with multiple uncertainties remains a fundamental challenge, particularly when nonlinear dynamics and operating-condition variations are intricately intertwined. Although deep reinforcement learning combined with domain randomization has shown promise in mitigating the sim-to-real gap, simultaneously handling all the sources of uncertainty often leads to sub-optimal policies and poor learning efficiency. This study proposes continual uncertainty learning (CUL), a curriculum-based continual learning framework for robust control of nonlinear systems on which multiple heterogeneous uncertainties are simultaneously superimposed. translated_title: 连续不确定性学习：用于具有多种异构不确定性的非线性系统鲁棒控制
translated_abstract: 摘要：具有多种不确定性的机械系统鲁棒控制仍是一个基本挑战，尤其是在非线性动力学与操作条件变化复杂交织的情况下。尽管深度强化学习结合域随机化在缓解仿真到现实差距方面显示出潜力，但同时处理所有不确定性来源往往会导致次优策略和较差的学习效率。本研究提出连续不确定性学习（CUL），这是一种基于课程学习的连续学习框架，用于同时叠加多种异构不确定性的非线性系统的鲁棒控制。核心思想是通过将系统扩展为一组不确定性逐步扩展和多样化的对象，将原始控制问题分解为一系列连续学习任务，从而使处理每种不确定性的策略得以逐步获取。
tldr: 本文提出连续不确定性学习（CUL）框架，通过课程式分解不确定性任务，实现非线性系统在多种异构不确定性下的高效鲁棒控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Continual Uncertainty Learning (CUL) framework that decomposes uncertainty tasks via curriculum learning to achieve efficient robust control of nonlinear systems under multiple heterogeneous uncertainties.
